description: Label and group Go ecosystem updates. The go directive in go.mod is a consumer compatibility floor, so it is kept out of the dependency group and off automerge. go.work is deliberately left alone: it is a local selector, not a floor, and nothing published reads it

packageRules.description: Group non-major Go module updates into a single PR

The go directive is the oldest Go a consumer may build this module with, not the Go this repo builds with. Renovate never raises it on its own: the stock go-mod-directive versioning only bumps the directive when a dependency demands it, so a floor left alone stays frozen indefinitely and nobody is told. loose versioning with a minor-precision extractVersion makes the update visible and keeps the two-component form a floor should have, while dependencyDashboardApproval stops it opening a PR by itself. Raising the floor of a published module is irreversible once the tag is on the module proxy, so it stays a deliberate human act. Applications, whose floor nobody reads, can drop the approval gate. Keep this rule after the group so the floor leaves it
